judgement.reason: OpenClaw's gateway keeps its core state, memory and credentials on local disk with no PostgreSQL or MySQL option, and Deployz containers start with an empty disk on every deploy.

evidence.quote: **Yours, with no catch.** State, memory, and credentials live on your hardware.
The [Gateway](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway) is the local control plane for sessions, tools, events, and channel connections.
